```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Serve the precompiled Quarto HTML.
# To update: re-render Time_Series.qmd.orig with Quarto, copy the
# output to inst/html_vignettes/Time_Series.html, and commit.
html <- paste(
  readLines(system.file("html_vignettes", "Time_Series.html",
                        package = "idealstan")),
  collapse = "\n"
)
body <- sub("(?s).*<body[^>]*>", "", html, perl = TRUE)
body <- sub("(?s)</body>.*",     "", body, perl = TRUE)
cat(body)
```
